markdownReuse.scope: Browser/native consistency, not independent child accuracy

consumerBuild.servedUsing: Existing Playground filesystem route; no new app/server/port

visibleOpaqueMultilineRegions.scope: Visible opaque multiline string regions; not independent test evidence

selection.selection: Highest fixed natural real-source validation macro F1 within the bound canonical protocol, with actual display/opaque-string review before test
selection.decision: Use canonical greedy output: 96.62% visible F1 and both opaque English/Unicode heredoc ranges exact. Joint decoding was not selected because it regressed visible Unicode despite a small validation gain. Validation is bounded at 88%; remaining limits are documented rather than tuning the independent test.
